faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the HAL Consultant / Experimental Test Pilot (Fixed Wing) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the HAL Consultant / Experimental Test Pilot (Fixed Wing) recruitment is 01-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by HAL?
faq.answer: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Consultant / Experimental Test Pilot (Fixed Wing).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Consultant / Experimental Test Pilot (Fixed Wing) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Consultant / Experimental Test Pilot (Fixed Wing) post is 61 years as of 01-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have successfully graduated as a Test Pilot on Fixed Wing Aircraft from ASTE, IAF or a recognized foreign Test Pilot School, with over 2000 hours of total flying and an ATPL with endorsement on Do 228/H-228/HS 748.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the HAL Consultant / Experimental Test Pilot (Fixed Wing) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an Interview.
